title: Raja Kumarudu, 1999
body: While on a holiday, Raja meets and falls in love with Rani but breaks off the relationship due to family compulsions. Later, when he has all but given up hope of seeing her again, he gets a surprise. Director: K. Raghavendra Rao. Total gross: 16cr (Share : 9.5cr). Verdict: Super Blockbuster.

title: Yuvaraju, 2000
body: A young man and his classmate fall in love with each other and decide to get married; everything goes smoothly till an unknown woman lands up at their engagement ceremony; soon the truth about his past is revealed. Director: Y.V.S. Chowdary. Total gross: 12.5cr (Share : 7.4cr). Verdict: Hit.

title: Vamsee, 2000
body: Vamsi, a fashion designer, falls in love with Shilpa, the daughter of a wealthy industrialist. When she is abducted by Arjun, her father begs Vamsi to rescue her despite his initial dislike for him. Director: Gopal B. Total gross: 7.15cr (Share : 4.25cr). Verdict: Disaster.

title: Murari, 2001
body: A family is under a curse due to an old sin; due to which a male is bound to die every 48 years. Director: Krishna Vamsi. Total gross: 17.25cr (Share : 10.2cr). Verdict: Hit.

title: Takkari Donga, 2002
body: Outlaw in the Indian (not Native American) wild west shoots it out with bad guys over a girl and a diamond mine. Director: Jayant Paranji. Total gross: 10.8cr (Share : 6.4cr). Verdict: Flop.

title: Bobby, 2002
body: Love between two youngsters leads to a dispute between two families. Director: Sobhan. Total gross: 6.3cr (Share : 3.75cr). Verdict: Disaster.

kicker: Idhi karnool kadhu ra, patha basthi..
title: Okkadu, 2003
body: A Kabbadi player rescues a young woman from an unwanted marriage and hides her in his home. Director: Gunasekhar. Total gross: 40.1cr (Share : 23.7cr). Verdict: Super Blockbuster.

title: Nijam, 2003
body: An innocent woman and her son face severe injustice at the hands of a villain. The woman also loses her husband in the bargain. Years later, she and her son avenge their losses in a planned manner. Director: Teja. Total gross: 17.7cr (Share : 10.6cr). Verdict: Below Average.

title: Naani, 2004
body: Naani is an 8 year old boy who attempts suicide, but is rescued by a scientist who changes his life completely with his invention. The boy had no clue that this will transform his life and teach him how to be a good son, lover and father. Director: S.J. Suryah. Total gross: 8.6cr (Share : 5.1cr). Verdict: Disaster.

title: Arjun, 2004
body: A young man risks his life to guarantee his twin sister's happiness and protect her from her murderous in-laws. Director: Gunasekhar Jasti Hemambar. Total gross: 23.9cr (Share : 13.9cr). Verdict: Above Average.

title: Athadu, 2005
body: A hitman, Nandu, is hired to stage the assassination of a politician. However, when the politician is actually killed and Nandu is framed for the murder, he assumes a dead man's identity to evade the law. Director: Trivikram Srinivas. Total gross: 30.6cr (Share : 17.6cr). Verdict: Hit.

title: Pokiri, 2006
body: Train Khairathabad ranathavarake Babu prince, vachaka superstar. Unna records anni madathapetti back pocket lo pettukunnadu

kicker: Decent movie, but not for BOB
title: Sainikudu, 2006
body: Siddharth strives to help flood victims and saves the relief material from falling into the wrong hands. This sets off a war between him and a corrupt politician, which leads to many twists and turns. Director: Gunasekhar. Total gross: 20cr (Share : 11.6cr). Verdict: Disaster.

title: Athidhi, 2007
body: Athidi(Mahesh Babu) is falsely convicted for killing his adopted parents and goes to jail for 13 years and when he comes back he loves Amrita (Amrita Rao) unaware that she is the daughter of his adopted parents. Director: Surender Reddy. Total gross: 31.5cr (Share : 18.3cr). Verdict: Below Average.

title: Khaleja, 2010
body: When a mysterious illness ravages a remote village, the villagers embrace a reluctant taxi driver as their savior. Director: Trivikram Srinivas. Total gross: 32.6cr (Share : 18.5cr). Verdict: Flop.

title: Dookudu, 2011
body: Ajay, (Mahesh Babu) an undercover cop, is assigned to catch a dangerous mafia don with whom he has a personal score to settle. Director: Sreenu Vaitla. Total gross: 95.5cr (Share : 56.6cr). Verdict: Blockbuster.

title: Business Man, 2012
body: A highly ambitious man visits Mumbai with the notion of ruling the city. He turns into a local gangster and manages to become a powerful businessman, though, his intentions are not what they seem. Director: Puri Jagannadh. Total gross: 70cr (Share : 40.5cr). Verdict: Hit.

title: Seethamma Vaakitlo Sirimalle Chettu, 2013
body: An exuberant and evocative family drama, that primarily revolves around the close bond between two brothers with radically different personalities, highlighting the complex process of choosing an ideal life partner for each of them. Director: Srikanth Addala. Total gross: 89.4cr (Share : 51.3cr). Verdict: Hit.

title: 1: Nenokkadine, 2014
body: A rock star must overcome his psychological inhibitions to seek revenge for his parents' death. Director: Sukumar. Total gross: 56.1cr (Share : 30.7cr). Verdict: Flop.

title: Aagadu, 2014
body: An encounter specialist is transferred as CI to a village which is ruled by a local gangster Director: Sreenu Vaitla. Total gross: 64.1cr (Share : 34.9cr). Verdict: Flop.

title: Srimanthudu, 2015
body: Harsha, a multi-millionaire's heir who has everything, still feels that there is something missing in his life. In an attempt to fill the void, he adopts a village to bring change in the people. Director: Koratala Siva. Total gross: 145.1cr (Share : 86.1cr). Verdict: Blockbuster.

title: Brahmotsavam, 2016
body: To consolidate his position in the family, a man tries to arrange a marriage for his daughter, but the suitable boy he has in mind is already in love with another. Director: Srikanth Addala. Total gross: 62.7cr (Share : 35.1cr). Verdict: Disaster.

title: Spyder, 2017
body: An intelligence officer attempts to save the city from a psychotic serial killer who kills people just to hear their loved ones cry. Director: A.R. Murugadoss. Total gross: 117.8cr (Share : 64.5cr). Verdict: Disaster.

title: Bharath Ane Nenu, 2018
body: Bharat, a young graduate who becomes the C.M of Andhra Pradesh (pre-div) after his father's demise without any political knowledge, faces challenges in the process of reforming the society. Director: Koratala Siva. Total gross: 164.9cr (Share : 100.2cr). Verdict: Hit.

kicker: Farmers desrves respect and BOB gave it.
title: Maharshi, 2019
body: A story about Rishi and his quest for success in different stages of life from being a US-based businessman to being a champion for the poor downtrodden farmers. Director: Vamshi Paidipally. Total gross: 170.5cr (Share : 100.1cr). Verdict: Hit.

kicker: Not BOB's level but a solid hit
title: Sarileru Neekevvaru, 2020
body: An Army Major -Ajay Krishna- is deployed to Kurnool on a mission and keeps the country safe from external threats. Director: Anil Ravipudi. Total gross: 214.8cr (Share : 127.3cr). Verdict: Super Hit.

title: Sarkaru Vaari Paata, 2022
body: After being conned by the woman he loves, a finance agent arrives in India from USA to retrieve his money from the woman's father who is a powerful MP and industrialist. Director: Parasuram. Total gross: 178.6cr (Share : 101.1cr). Verdict: Above Average.

title: Guntur Kaaram, 2024
body: Years after his mother abandons him and remarries, a man demands answers when he's asked to sign a document denying he is her son as she runs for office. Director: Trivikram Srinivas. Total gross: 170.3cr (Share : 97.3cr). Verdict: Below Average.

title: Vaaranasi, Upcoming
body: The most anticipated SSR-SSMB collaboration: Vaaranasi. A dream combination for fans, carrying massive expectations, global-scale imagination, and the kind of hype only Mahesh Babu with S. S. Rajamouli can create.
